contracts: 0x001AC0D2 is the shared five-caller actor-collision transition block for the Type-24/25/27/28 companion paths and the direct Type-0x84 response entry.
The block releases the current actor's resources and common state, installs type 0x84 with ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE84_COLLISION_RESPONSE, and clears the animation timer.
ActorType23_SpawnCollisionResponsePair also uses this transition before allocating its companion actors.
limitations: The promoted name identifies the transition role, while the precise user-facing effect of the installed collision-response animation remains defined by the animation stream and its callers.
The legacy animation-address name remains an alias for historical findings and downstream references.
conclusion: The shared actor-collision Type-0x84 transition now has a stable collision-response identity instead of an animation-address-bearing name.
